data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 308 (Life) carried opening long-term business reserves (gross claims-type reserves) of GBP 8.047m at 1 January 2015 (prior year comparative on the balance sheet). No explicit gross prior-year reserve movement (gross movement in prior years' claims provision) is clearly quantified in the available notes; therefore a gross prior-year movement cannot be determined from the report. The managing agent noted higher than normal loss frequency and some larger individual losses in 2015 which pressured the underwriting result (combined ratio reported at c.107.9%).
raw_causal_phrases: affected the US binder book as well as the UK Police Federation account
a couple of larger individual losses
data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from the Syndicate 308 balance sheet (Long-term business provision) -- prior-year (2014) comparative column used. No explicit GROSS prior-year development (movement in prior years' claims provision) was found in the notes in a clear 'Insurance liabilities (gross)' column; P&L 'claims incurred in relation to prior underwriting years' lines were present but per instructions are NOT valid sources for reserve movement. A gross claims development triangle exists but values in the published image are ambiguous for diagonal comparison; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is returned as null. Where only net/after-reinsurance prior year movement is quoted in narrative, it was not used because no gross figure was located.
